What Is AI SEO?

AI SEO refers to the application of AI technology and techniques that assist in making a site visible on not only regular search engines but also on AI-based search engines.

The other names for this term are Artificial Intelligence SEO, which includes concepts like machine learning, search intent, content optimization, technical SEO, and decision-making.

Unlike conventional SEO approaches that focus primarily on keywords and rankings, AI SEO focuses on:

User intent Contextual relevance Semantic search Content quality Entity recognition Search behavior patterns

The result is stronger visibility, better content performance, and improved organic growth.
